shortDescription: Create or Delete QoS DSCP trust modes on AOS-CX.

options.name: code_point
options.description: 6-bit integer value used to mark packets for different per-hop behavior as defined by IETF RFC2474. It is carried within the Differentiated Services (DS) field of the IPv4 or IPv6 header. Used as an identifier.

options.name: color
options.description: String to identify the color which may be used later in the pipeline in packet-drop decision points.

options.name: cos
options.description: Priority Code Point (PCP) that will be assigned to any IP packet with the specified DSCP codepoint, if that packet's ingress port has an effective trust mode of DSCP. The new PCP is used when the packet is transmitted out of a port or trunk with a VLAN tag. If the key is not specified, then no remark will occur.

options.name: local_priority
options.description: Integer to represent an internal meta-data value that will be associated with the packet. This value will be used later to select the egress queue for the packet.
